home.title: PRESA | Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu School in Tenerife
home.subtitle: BJJ academy in La Laguna, Santa Cruz de Tenerife. Classes for all levels, events, seminars and competition.

events.heading: A community in motion
events.intro: Our gym is always active. Throughout the year we run events, seminars, special training sessions and open classes that enrich the experience of all our students and foster an environment of constant improvement. Practitioners of all levels and academies come together here.

store.heading: Gear Up
store.intro: Explore our collection of apparel and accessories while helping power our events: the profit from every purchase goes toward the prize pool for the competitions and activities we organize.

academy.heading: Train with us
academy.intro: Kimono GI and No-Gi Grappling classes for every level, from your first trial class to competition. Discover our schedule, methodology and the team behind it.

extra.text: Every class adds up: technique, discipline and community. That's what training at Presa looks like, on and off the mats.
extra.videoAlt: Video of a Presa Academy class
extra.secondaryText: We have two formats: Kimono Gi and Grappling. Whether you're a beginner or an advanced level, you can join our classes.

manifesto.text2: La Laguna will once again become a benchmark for grappling in Spain, bringing together competitors from every island alongside top-level guest athletes, both national and international.

cards.title: Gi Jiu-Jitsu
cards.description: The traditional art, trained in the kimono. Collar and sleeve grips open up a rich game of control, sweeps and submissions built on patience and technique.
cards.more: Gi classes emphasise grip fighting, guard retention and the fundamentals that carry over to every level. Ideal if you want a deep, methodical understanding of Jiu-Jitsu — from your first day to your black belt.

cards.title: No-Gi Grappling
cards.description: Fast, dynamic and slippery. Without the kimono the game speeds up, rewarding pressure, body control and a relentless pace on the mat.
cards.more: No-Gi focuses on underhooks, body locks and wrestling-based control, with a game that translates directly to competition and MMA. A great complement to Gi or a discipline in its own right.

schedule.heading: Schedule
schedule.intro: Train at your own pace and find the schedule that best fits your day-to-day. We offer classes for kids and adults, organized in mixed groups, where every student learns and grows alongside their peers in an atmosphere of respect and collaboration.

trial.text: Come try it out, no strings attached.

join.heading: TRAIN. COMPETE. RISE.
join.description: Our team of certified coaches is committed to helping you reach your goals, whether you want to compete, build confidence, or improve your overall fitness. We build a training plan tailored to you.

points.title: Open to every level
points.text: Everyone starts from zero at some point. No prior experience or fitness level required: each student steps onto the mat at their own pace, with a method that adapts from day one.

points.title: Discipline, respect and growth
points.text: These are the foundation the whole art is built on. On the mat we're all equal, regardless of belt, age or strength - here you learn to win with humility and lose with dignity, on and off the mats.

points.title: More than a sport
points.text: BJJ teaches you to stay calm under pressure, trust your preparation, and find solutions from a place of composure. The confidence you build on the mat stays with you in every challenge that follows.

points.title: You never train alone
points.text: Individual progress is born from teamwork. From your first class you'll be part of a group that celebrates your progress, shares what it knows, and pushes you to give a little more in every session.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about the academy and how it works. Can't find your answer? Get in touch and we'll help.

questions.question: Is there an age limit to start?
questions.answer: No. We have groups for kids from age 5 and adult classes with no age limit. Every student trains at their own pace, and we adapt the intensity whenever needed.

questions.question: Do I need to buy a kimono before I start?
questions.answer: You won't need one for your first class. If you decide to continue, we'll point you to where you can buy one so you can pick an option that fits your size, budget and preferences.

questions.question: I've never done a contact sport, do I need previous experience?
questions.answer: You don't need any previous experience. Many people start from scratch and classes are designed to learn step by step. You'll train with partners of different levels, always in a controlled way and adapted to your pace.

questions.question: Can I compete?
questions.answer: Yes. Competing is entirely optional, but anyone who wants to compete will get technical support and specific preparation ahead of each tournament.

questions.question: How are the groups organized?
questions.answer: Groups are organized mainly by age and level, with classes for beginners and general classes. This way, every student can train safely, progress at their own pace and share the mat with training partners suited to their experience.

questions.question: What age can my child start?
questions.answer: Kids can start from age 5. We have two children's groups, ages 5 to 9 and 10 to 13, so classes suit each stage.

questions.question: Does my child need a kimono from day one?
questions.answer: It's not necessary for the trial class. If they decide to continue, we'll point you to where to buy a kimono suited to their size and age.

questions.question: Can parents stay and watch the class?
questions.answer: Yes. We have a viewing area set up so parents can watch the class comfortably.

questions.question: What do the kids do during class?
questions.answer: Classes combine kimono and grappling techniques adapted to their age with games and dynamic exercises. Beyond learning Jiu Jitsu, kids work on coordination, focus, discipline and respect for their teammates.
